nora (devex): FYI a few users reported our sample app on edge failing after the latest SDK package.json change. Console: ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED.

liam (eng-runtime): Do we have the new exports block?

nora (devex): Copied from release branch package.json:
```json
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./*": {
    "node": "./lib/node/*.cjs",
    "default": "./lib/esm/*.js"
  }
}
```

ana (ana?) (eng): Wildcard + conditional combos are fragile for edge bundlers and Vite. Those tools often don't honor the "node" condition and then the request to the package root ends up unresolved.

vik (eng-platform): The symptom we see is the resolver asking for '/' and not finding a concrete mapping, then the bundler falls back and picks a cjs file that crashes with "Cannot use import statement outside a module".

liam (eng-runtime): Minimal repro: in a Vercel edge worker, `import { create } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'` blows up. The fix we used in a local branch was to add an explicit dot entrypoint and explicit import/require keys:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./lib/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./lib/node/index.cjs",
    "default": "./lib/esm/index.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
This ensures bundlers map the package root to a concrete file instead of trying to expand wildcards.

nora (devex): After switching to that mapping my Vercel deploy succeeded. I'll open a PR.

vik (eng-platform): Also double-check package.json fields: "types" should point to the .d.ts in the esm output and consider setting "exports" entries for subpath imports we expect users to use (e.g., "./runtime", "./client"). Otherwise some bundlers will still try to reach into package tree.

ana (eng): We should add a CI smoke test that bundles the sample with esbuild and runs a node ESM import check. Quick scripts: `esbuild sample/index.ts --bundle --format=esm` and `node --input-type=module -e "import('@redwood/inference-sdk').then(()=>console.log('ok'))"`

liam (eng-runtime): I also recommend documenting the supported resolver conditions in our CONTRIBUTING.md (import/require/browser/worker/default) and a note on avoiding pattern-matching exports for the public API surface.

nora (devex): PR 2412 incoming: adds dot entry, updates types field, and a tiny esbuild smoke test in CI. I'll add a short note to the SDK migration guide.

deploy-bot: Deploy check: release/2026.03.21 1:14 UTC 1 failing job: edge-sample-bundle. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/edge-2412

vik (eng-platform): Holding release until the PR passes. Thanks for spotting this early.
